documents.title: Conference Call with the Fund Managers, Analysts and Investors - Transcript
Presentation - Conference Call with the Fund Managers, Analysts and Investors on October 29, 2026

analysis.summary: Wheels India Limited reported financial results for Q2 FY27, noting that export revenues grew by 30% year-on-year in Q2 FY27 and 23% year-on-year in H1 FY27. Management estimated the capex for FY27 to be between Rs 400 to Rs 450 crs. The company operates in two business segments namely automotive products and industrial products, and focused on strategic areas like growing exports, scaling up cast aluminium and wind energy components, and optimizing working capital. Wheels India Limited released its investor presentation for Q1 FY27, reporting consolidated gross revenues of Rs 1,492.79 Cr and PAT of Rs 38.94 Cr. Management outlined a standalone capex estimate of Rs 400 to Rs 450 crores for FY27.

guidance.claim: Capex for FY27 is estimated to be between Rs 400 to Rs 450 crs.
guidance.quote: Capex of FY27 is estimated to be in the region of Rs 400 to Rs 450 crs

capex_expansion.claim: The capex is directed towards capacity expansion in auto steel wheels, cast alloy wheels, energy products division including large machining, hydraulic cylinders, construction & mining wheels and air suspension.
capex_expansion.quote: This capex is towards expansion of capacity in auto steel wheels, cast alloy wheels, energy products division including large machining, hydraulic cylinders, construction & mining wheels and air suspension .

capex_expansion.claim: Capex for FY27 is estimated to be in the region of Rs 400 to Rs 450 crs.
capex_expansion.quote: Capex of FY27 is estimated to be in the region of Rs 400 to Rs 450 crs

capex_expansion.claim: The company spent about INR261 crores towards capex last year across windmills, aluminium, off-road businesses, routine capex, and cost savings.
capex_expansion.quote: In terms of capex, last year, we basically spent about INR261 crores towards capex, which is both in terms of investment towards the windmill business, aluminium business and a little bit of the off-road businesses and some routine capex and cost savings totalling INR261 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Management expects capex in the current year to be between INR280 crores and INR300 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: And we expect in the current year, it will be between INR280 crores to INR300 crores of capex.

capex_expansion.claim: The capex approved by the Board for FY27 is about INR280 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: One is the capex approved for the Board is about INR280 crores at the moment.

margins_costs.claim: Cost optimization remains a focus with a thrust on profitability.
margins_costs.quote: Cost optimization, with a thrust on profitability

margins_costs.claim: Inventory provisions were higher because the company adopted a more stringent rule for provisioning.
margins_costs.quote: The inventory provisions are higher, though it is grouped together. And inventory provisions are higher because a company has adopted a more stringent rule for provisioning.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's aluminium wheel capacity is currently about 42,000 per month and is increasing to 60,000 in a few months, and then to 80,000 by the half year.
orders_capacity.quote: In aluminium wheels we currently have a capacity of about 42,000 per month. We are increasing it -- in a few months we are increasing it to 60,000 and then by half year, we'll increase it to 80,000.

capital_allocation.claim: The company plans to fund capex predominantly through accruals and hold debt at current levels.
capital_allocation.quote: Fund capex predominantly thro accruals and holding the debt at current levels

capital_allocation.claim: Debt is maintained at Q1 FY27 levels.
capital_allocation.quote: Debt is maintained at Q1 FY27 levels.

capital_allocation.claim: The company reduced its inventory days from 76 days to 63 days.
capital_allocation.quote: So we've reduced our inventory from 76 days to 63 days.

capital_allocation.claim: The company reduced its debtor days from 61 to 54.
capital_allocation.quote: We have reduced our debtor days from 61 to 54.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that industrial fuel costs went up far ahead of what happened for citizens, causing an increase as far back as March last year.
risks_headwinds.quote: Industrial fuel costs went up far ahead of what has happened for the citizens of the country. So we had increases even as far back as March last year.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the capex of FY27 is estimated to be in the region of Rs 400 to Rs 450 crs.
management_commitments.quote: Capex of FY27 is estimated to be in the region of Rs 400 to Rs 450 crs

management_commitments.claim: Management expects double-digit EBITDA to happen from strategy and loss-making businesses becoming positive within 1 to 2 years.
management_commitments.quote: So I think as and when that happens, I think we're probably 2 years away -- 1 or 2 years away from double-digit EBITDA. I don't think it should take longer than that.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets an ROCE of 18% plus and a return on equity of 15% plus.
management_commitments.quote: I would look at our ROCE being 18% plus, I would look at our return on equity to be 15% plus.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
